top_signals.title: America Produces Less Than 1% of the Rare Earth Magnets It Needs
top_signals.summary: China’s ongoing weaponization of rare earths, which has now been bolstered to include measures to keep individuals with sensitive technological knowledge from leaving the country, gives it leverage over a $1.5 trillion U.S. civilian economy that depends on permanent magnets. The Pentagon has spent years preparing for life without Chinese rare earths, but the civilian economy hasn't. IMF researchers identified 34 sectors of the U.S. economy with direct exposure to rare earth supply disruptions, while the International Energy Agency (IEA) estimates…

top_signals.title: Aftermath of Spanish Train Crash Near Madrid
top_signals.summary: At least 30 people have died in a collision between two high-speed trains south of Madrid, according to a spokesperson for the regional government of Castilla-La Mancha. (Source: Capital Radio/Guardia Civil)

top_signals.title: Inside America's Prediction Market Boom
top_signals.summary: Emily Chang hits the streets of New York with Tarek Mansour, who along with Luana Lopes Lara created Kalshi, the biggest prediction market in the world. The co-founders face a host of new competitors, vocal opponents and a very public debate about what the platform really is and its impact on society. (Source: Bloomberg)
